config.advertiser_summary: An affordable workout supplement brand offering pre-workout, creatine, and protein formulations identical to expensive brands at half the cost.

assumptions: Price not given; assumed $25 for a 'budget' product.
Gross margin not given; assumed 65% (typical for wellness_dtc).
repeat_consumable: assumed 2.5 orders per customer over ~6 months.
Target CPA = 70% of max affordable CAC ($25 x 65% margin x 2.5 orders = $40.62).

pricing.rationale: Acquisition goal with no conversion history: pay per click. Max CPC = target CPA $28.44 x click-to-purchase rate (1.5%-5.0%). Clicks are observable without trusting a pixel, so both sides can verify billing.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded; until then Disco can't predict conversion rate for this brand.

budget.pacing: even daily pacing; pause a host if CPA > 2.0x target after 150 clicks

allocations.rationale: score 0.30 -> fit x1.40 on CTR/CVR; max bid $1.19 (break-even at target CPA), start at 70% and raise only if under-delivering; host sells a competing product, so it may decline (capacity discounted)
